sbi_http_errors.400: Bad Request - Schema mismatch or malformed JSON syntax
sbi_http_errors.401: Unauthorized - Authentication vector or K/OPc key validation failure
sbi_http_errors.403: Forbidden - Subscription profile lacks permission for selected DNN/Slice
sbi_http_errors.404: Not Found - Identity absent or NF not registered in NRF catalog
sbi_http_errors.405: Method Not Allowed - HTTP method invalid for target SBI resource
sbi_http_errors.406: Not Acceptable - S-NSSAI Slice is geographically blocked at this TAI
sbi_http_errors.409: Conflict - Resource already exists or concurrent update collision
sbi_http_errors.411: Length Required - Missing Content-Length header in SBI signaling
sbi_http_errors.413: Payload Too Large - JSON message exceeds node buffer capacity limit
sbi_http_errors.415: Unsupported Media Type - Content-Type header is not application/json
sbi_http_errors.429: Too Many Requests - SCP/Proxy overload protection mechanism active
sbi_http_errors.500: Internal Server Error - Microservice pod crash or UDR database drop
sbi_http_errors.503: Service Unavailable - Element active but isolated in traffic draining mode
sbi_http_errors.504: Gateway Timeout - Multi-node cascading latency or thread freeze

404.name: HTTP 404 Not Found
404.desc: The AMF requested subscription profile lookups over the N8 interface, but the target SUPI string does not exist.
404.ts: Validate subscriber provisioning variables inside the UDR central database cluster.

504.name: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout
504.desc: Cascading interface latency. The AMF signaling loop timed out waiting for the SMF context validation on the N11 interface.
504.ts: Increase signaling guard parameters and monitor background container CPU metrics.

nas_mobility_errors_5gs.3: Illegal UE - Core authentication handshake failure or blacklisted IMEI
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.7: 5GS services not allowed - 5G Standalone access disabled in profile
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.9: UE identity cannot be derived - Invalid or expired 5G-GUTI pointer
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.11: PLMN not allowed - Inter-operator roaming violation across SEPP boundary
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.22: Congestion - AMF core engine is temporarily overloaded with registrations
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.27: N1 mode not allowed - Native 5G control plane layer restricted for SIM
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.31: Redirection to EPC required - Forced technology fallback to 4G LTE via N26
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.65: Maximum number of PDU sessions reached - Exceeded concurrent policy cap
nas_mobility_errors_5gs.72: Non-3GPP access to 5GCN not allowed - Untrusted Wi-Fi connection blocked

nas_session_errors_5gs.26: Insufficient resources - Dyn IP pool exhaustion or node memory bottleneck
nas_session_errors_5gs.28: Unknown or missing DNN - Mismatched or unprovisioned network APN name
nas_session_errors_5gs.32: Service option not subscribed - Unauthorized QoS profile or 5QI request
nas_session_errors_5gs.38: Network failure - Critical PFCP tunnel teardown across N4 interface to UPF
nas_session_errors_5gs.43: Invalid PDU session identity - UE sent a non-existent or duplicate Session ID

403.name: SIP 403 Forbidden
403.desc: The IMS Core accepted the request, but the Telephony Application Server (TAS) explicitly rejects execution because the MSISDN lacks a voice provisioning profile.
403.ts: Verify user flags inside the HSS/UDM. Ensure the TAS database has replicated the corresponding iFC (Initial Filter Criteria).

404.name: SIP 404 Not Found
404.desc: The dialed string (Tel URI / SIP URI) matches no valid routing entries inside the translation tables.
404.ts: Check local ENUM or internal DNS records on the S-CSCF server layer.

488.name: SIP 488 Not Acceptable Here
488.desc: Critical Session Description Protocol (SDP) audio codec negotiation mismatch.
488.ts: Ensure the device supports HD Voice (EVS or AMR-WB). Enable transcodification profiles on the MRFP gateway node.

504.name: SIP 504 Server Time-out
504.desc: The P-CSCF edge controller received no response from the downstream S-CSCF proxy inside the T1 guard timer windows.
504.ts: Audit internal IP routing planes and check session state capacity limits on the core elements.

legacy_4g_nas_emm_emm.2: IMSI unknown in HSS - User not provisioned in the 4G HSS database
legacy_4g_nas_emm_emm.5: IMEI not accepted - Device serial number blocked by EIR
legacy_4g_nas_emm_emm.8: EPS services not allowed - 4G LTE packet access blocked for this user
legacy_4g_nas_emm_emm.14: GPRS services not allowed in this PLMN - Legacy data roaming restriction
legacy_4g_nas_emm_emm.15: No Suitable Cells In Tracking Area - Core rejects attachment in this grid location

legacy_4g_diameter_errors_s6a.5001: DIAMETER_ERROR_USER_UNKNOWN - IMSI completely absent from 4G HSS database
legacy_4g_diameter_errors_s6a.5003: DIAMETER_ERROR_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN - Host/Realm mismatch during Diameter routing
legacy_4g_diameter_errors_s6a.5005: DIAMETER_ERROR_IDENTITY_REJECTED - Security credential failure on HSS handshake

legacy_2g_3g_map_errors_ss7.1: Unknown Subscriber - IMSI absent from legacy HLR core node
legacy_2g_3g_map_errors_ss7.11: Teleservice Not Provisioned - User has no permission for Voice/SMS/Data payload
legacy_2g_3g_map_errors_ss7.13: Roaming Not Allowed - National or international boundary restriction
legacy_2g_3g_map_errors_ss7.34: System Failure - SS7/SIGTRAN STP routing collapse or database freeze

fallas_nodos_5g.causa_raiz: El vector de autenticación (RAND/AUTN) enviado por la AUSF falló la validación criptográfica en la tarjeta SIM del dispositivo móvil.
fallas_nodos_5g.solucion_L3: Verificar si las llaves maestras K y OPc están correctamente aprovisionadas e idénticas tanto en la UDM/UDR como en el fabricante de la SIM card.

fallas_nodos_5g.causa_raiz: La AMF solicitó el perfil de movilidad (Subscription Data) a la UDM, pero la identidad del usuario (SUPI/IMSI) no existe en la base de datos central.
fallas_nodos_5g.solucion_L3: Validar si el usuario fue dado de alta correctamente en el sistema de aprovisionamiento (HSS/UDM). Comprobar sincronización con el CRM/HLR.

fallas_nodos_5g.causa_raiz: La AMF intentó iniciar la sesión de datos, pero la SMF no respondió dentro del temporizador de guardia debido a saturación en la asignación de direcciones IP.
fallas_nodos_5g.solucion_L3: Revisar los pools de direccionamiento IPv4/IPv6 asignados al DNN (Data Network Name) en la SMF. Verificar logs de consumo de CPU/Memoria del nodo.

fallas_nodos_5g.causa_raiz: La PCF rechazó la solicitud de políticas porque el perfil del usuario no tiene permitido el identificador de calidad de servicio (5QI) solicitado para esta sesión (ej. rebanada de red/Slice incorrecto).
fallas_nodos_5g.solucion_L3: Revisar las reglas de control de políticas de cuotas (PCC Rules) en la PCF. Validar compatibilidad del Network Slice (S-NSSAI) configurado en el dispositivo.

fallas_nodos_5g.causa_raiz: Falla crítica en el protocolo PFCP (Packet Forwarding Control Protocol). La SMF no pudo establecer las reglas de reenvío de datos en el plano de usuario (UPF).
fallas_nodos_5g.solucion_L3: Monitorear el estado del enlace físico/lógico de la interfaz N4. Validar que las direcciones de los nodos GTP-U estén respondiendo al ping de control.
